name: HivePunk 547
subject: Mem0
thesis: Mem0 is a credible, actively maintained memory tool with strong self-reported benchmark results, but its headline numbers depend partly on proprietary managed-platform features. The open-source and managed versions should therefore be evaluated separately.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: mem0ai/mem0 has 7 raw commits in the last 30 days, 5 of them real work (not docs, formatting, bots, templates or trivial).

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Its latest real commit is f1791da, on 2026-11-06.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Mem0 enhances AI assistants and agents with an intelligent memory layer enabling personalized interactions.
claims.quote: Mem0 ("mem-zero") enhances AI assistants and agents with an intelligent memory layer, enabling personalized AI interactions.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Mem0 provides multi-level memory retaining User, Session, and Agent state.
claims.quote: Multi-Level Memory : Seamlessly retains User, Session, and Agent state with adaptive personalization

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Mem0 reports LoCoMo improving from 71.4 to 92.5, using 7.0K tokens with 0.88s p50 latency.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Mem0's benchmark scores reflect its managed platform, including proprietary optimizations not available in the open-source SDK.
claims.quote: Scores reflect Mem0's managed platform, which includes proprietary optimizations not available in the open-source SDK; open-source users should expect directionally similar gains but not identical numbers.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Mem0 uses single-pass ADD-only extraction with one LLM call and no UPDATE/DELETE, so memories accumulate and are not overwritten.
claims.quote: Single-pass ADD-only extraction -- one LLM call, no UPDATE/DELETE. Memories accumulate; nothing is overwritten.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Mem0's multi-signal retrieval scores semantic, BM25 keyword, and entity matching in parallel and fuses them.
claims.quote: Multi-signal retrieval -- semantic, BM25 keyword, and entity matching scored in parallel and fused.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: mem0ai/mem0 has 7 raw commits in the last 30 days, 5 of them real work.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: The latest real commit is f1791da, on 2026-11-06.

claims.label: UNKNOWN
claims.text: Whether independent evaluators reproduced Mem0's benchmark results using only the open-source SDK is not shown in the pages read.
claims.missing: An independent reproduction report using the open-source SDK and the same evaluation framework

claims.label: UNKNOWN
claims.text: Mem0's pricing, data-retention, user-deletion, and security-audit status are not established by the pages read.
claims.missing: Official pricing, privacy/data-retention, deletion, and security documentation pages

risks: Headline benchmark scores come from the managed platform with proprietary optimizations, so open-source users should not expect identical numbers.
Single-pass ADD-only extraction means memories accumulate and are not overwritten, raising questions about stale or incorrect memories persisting.
Benchmark claims are presented by Mem0 itself; independent reproduction results were not in the pages read.
Several related repositories shown on the organisation page are archived, which could confuse users about which components are actively maintained.
The pages read did not provide pricing, data-retention, deletion, or security-audit details sufficient to assess deployment risk.
unknowns: Whether independent evaluators reproduced Mem0's benchmark results using only the open-source SDK is not shown in the pages read.: An independent reproduction report using the open-source SDK and the same evaluation framework
Mem0's pricing, data-retention, user-deletion, and security-audit status are not established by the pages read.: Official pricing, privacy/data-retention, deletion, and security documentation pages
wouldChangeMind: Independent reproduction matching the headline scores with the open-source SDK alone.
A clear official explanation of memory correction and deletion despite ADD-only extraction.
Evidence that recent commit activity has slowed or that the main repository is no longer the recommended product.
